Quick intro — I'm Emily, program lead at StratusAI. We're running a 12-week accelerator in Q1 and will shortlist ~30 early-stage teams that will ramp very quickly during the first 4–6 weeks for demo day. We're evaluating partner credits / promotional packs to ensure teams can run realistic workloads without being cut off mid-demo.

A few initial questions:

- Can credits be reassigned between participant companies if a team drops out?
- Any procurement or billing hoops we should expect for cohort-wide sponsorships?

Hi Emily — great to meet you, and congrats on the cohort lineup. We do a few things that map to what you're describing:

1) Tiered Accelerator Pack (what I call the Starter -> Ramp -> Demo structure):
   - Starter: $5k in credits per team for onboarding (first 30 days)
   - Ramp: additional $15k in credits per team unlocked after MAAP milestones (next 60 days)
   - Demo buffer: a shared pool of $50k to handle burst demo-day load across the cohort

2) Early-consumption safeguard: we can set per-team monthly pacing limits and an automatic throttle if a team exceeds an agreed burn threshold. Throttles are reversible after review.

3) Reassignment: standard policy is that credits are tied to the billed legal entity. That said, for accelerator sponsors we can approve a one-time reassignment window (subject to signature on sponsor agreement and finance sign-off).

Next steps I propose: 20–30m call to confirm expected concurrency/peak token rates, then I can share a draft MAAP (mutual action and consumption plan) and a proposed DocuSign. I'm attaching a rough MAAP template — will flesh after the call.

Are you available 10/21 at 11am PT?

Best,
Ben

Emily

Subject: Re: Intro: credits for our accelerator cohort? — policy notes and options

Emily — looping in a couple policy and finance clarifications from our end. Quick bullets to make procurement's life easier:

- Expiry: Promotional credits that are part of an accelerator sponsorship default to 12 months from grant date. We can compress to 6 months or extend to 18 months for strategic partners via a sponsorship SOW, but extensions require Finance approval.

- Reassignment: Credits are normally non-transferable across distinct legal entities. For sponsored accelerators we offer a Sponsored Umbrella Account model: sponsor signs a sponsor agreement and becomes the billing entity; credits can be distributed to cohort teams and reassigned within that umbrella during a 30-day reassignment window. This requires a one-time sponsor onboarding checklist and an indemnity clause (standard).

- Discounting on committed capacity: for an upfront sponsor commitment (30 teams, estimated commit $450k over 12 months) we can offer a 7–12% discount on unit token price depending on minimum committed spend and whether dedicated reserved capacity is required.

- Demo-day burst capacity: we can provision ephemeral reserved lanes (pre-warm GPUs) for demo-day windows for an extra fee. We also support a shared demo buffer pool (Ben suggested $50k) which we monitor and auto-top if the cohort hits >85% buffer.

I've attached our internal credit policy summary for procurement reference. If you want, we can include the sponsor umbrella option in the MAAP and draft an amendment to the standard promo T&Cs to enable the 30-day reassignment window.

cc: Stephanie — can you flag any legal constraints I missed?

Marissa
